description: Multimodal color-perception eval: given an image, extract its dominant color palette as hex codes. Accuracy is measured deterministically via CIEDE2000 delta-E against ground-truth hex values and fed into the judge prompt as objective context; judges still score the five standard dimensions. Requires vision-capable models (set "vision": true on the model entry in models.json).

test_cases.name: PLACEHOLDER — replace with your first image
test_cases.prompt: Look at the image and extract its 4-6 most dominant colors. Return ONLY a JSON array of hex codes in descending order of visual dominance, nothing else. Example: ["#aabbcc", "#112233", "#ddeeff"]
test_cases.reference_answer: A JSON array of 4-6 hex codes matching the dominant colors in the image. Ground-truth hex codes are listed in expected_colors; the color-matching block in the judge prompt will show CIEDE2000 deltas against them.

scoring_criteria.completeness: All dominant ground-truth colors are represented in the output (see the Color Matching section: 1 missing = penalty)
scoring_criteria.accuracy: Extracted hex codes are perceptually close to the ground truth (primary signal: the CIEDE2000 table in the judge prompt)
scoring_criteria.format: Pure JSON array of hex strings, no prose, no code fences, no trailing commas
scoring_criteria.domain_relevance: Colors actually present in the image, not generic web-palette defaults
scoring_criteria.clarity: Output is a valid, parseable JSON array
